Title: Does Frontal Assault override action restrictions?

Messages.Author: prunesquallor
Messages.Body:
I have Frontal Assault in play :

> Frontal Assault
> Master.
> Put this card in play. Each ready minion you control may enter combat with any minion controlled by your prey as a  action. You gain 1 pool each time a ready minion controlled by your prey is burned or sent to torpor. During your influence phase, burn this card and burn 1 pool for each ready minion controlled by your prey.
>
Inspired by an old hypothetical decklist by Darby, I have a Hellhound (riding a Hawg, wearting a leather jacket, and wielding a combat shotgun).

> Hellhound
>
> 2
> Ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
> The Hellhound cannot take actions. If the Hellhound has only 1 life during your untap phase, it gains 1 life from the blood bank.
>
Does the Frontal Assault allow the Hellhound to take an action to enter combat with one of my prey's minions?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> prunesquallor wrote:
> Does the Frontal Assault allow the Hellhound to take an action to enter combat with one of my prey's minions?
>
No.

Frontal Assault grants an action that minions can choose to take. But Hell Hound cannot take actions, so its expanded number of choices is irrelevant.
